minecraft:written_book_content.author: the Hermit
pages: {"text": "I was chaplain to the Gearwrights. I blessed the First Gate when they cut it, at the Hollow, the valley the Guild is named for.\n\nI said the words. I believed them."}
{"text": "The draught came up through the Hollow first. The smoke on the horizon, the bell at midnight, the pale groves. All of it started there.\n\nThe Guild knew within a year."}
{"text": "They built more gates. Gatehouses in the wilds, a station Below, another Beyond. Each one to fix the last.\n\nI left. I keep a light on in case anyone comes asking."}
{"text": "You are asking. The nearest gatehouse is marked on the map in this chest.\n\nRead their registers. Then decide what you think of men who keep records instead of stopping."}
